## Hosting & Domain Policy
- 1st-Year Domain (`.in` or `.com`) and High-Speed Cloud Hosting are 100% included in all packages.
- Zero monthly retainers or hidden platform software subscriptions.
- 0% commission on orders. All customer payments go directly to merchant's UPI/bank account.

## Core Capabilities
- Direct WhatsApp Ordering: Customers browse catalog and send structured orders straight to merchant's WhatsApp.
